# ADR-0032: Defer Car Assistant and Growing Gardens BI adoption until owner resumption

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Type:** strategy
- **Date:** 2026-09-13
- **Scope:** Named-consumer priority only; ADR-0017/0018/0020/0024 remain binding

## Context

The owner has put Car Assistant and Growing Gardens BI adoption on hold because
neither is a current priority. The [inventory](../assessments/2026-09-13-adoption-inventory.md)
already records shared shell/navigation/appearance in their dirty working trees,
missing adoption selections/routing, and separate browser/host/delivery evidence gaps.
Those observations do not authorize follow-on consumer work or prove its completion.

## Decision

Defer further adoption work in these two apps, including contracts, selections,
agent routers, shell changes, host setup and upgrade/browser proof. Do not write to
either consumer or repeat approval prompts for this deferred work. Do not select
replacement apps automatically to continue the same adoption stream.

Retain the dated evidence, existing integrations and unrelated working-tree changes.
The separately owner-approved Growing Gardens BI finance/export repair and its
regression evidence remain valid history; this priority change does not undo them.

Keep kit-local discovery, Gallery specimens and scoped verification independent of
this deferral. G1–G6 are not completed by changing priorities. G2 still requires two
owner-selected consumers to exercise the composed workflow and applicable states;
G3 still needs at least two apps' own-data checks and measured task/performance results;
G4 still needs actual host routing, sibling-free delivery and a reviewed improvement
reaching a second consumer. Missing evidence remains missing, not passed or waived.

Layer-specific promotion under ADR-0017/0018 is unchanged: fixtures, documentation,
downstream verification and replacement of the original fork remain required where
applicable; L3b/L4 permanent components still need two consumers, a Gallery page,
an upgrade note and an accessibility contract. Static checks are not host/runtime
proof under ADR-0020/0024. Consumer identity, domain policy and authority stay local.

## Consequences

The named-pair work moves to [futures](../intent/futures.md), without deleting its
evidence or expanding another app's scope. Complete promotion/propagation claims
may wait for authorized consumer work. No API, compatibility or runtime behavior
changes; no consumer migration, release or goal completion is implied.

## Revisit when

- The owner explicitly resumes adoption for Car Assistant or Growing Gardens BI
  and names the current app/task. Refresh its intent, working-tree evidence and
  scoped authority before work; do not assume both apps resume together.
- The owner explicitly selects a different current consumer/task; evaluate that
  scope separately, without silently resuming either deferred app or relaxing gates.
